2.  The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed for quashing the proceedings as well as the summoning order dated 11.03.2022 passed in Complaint Case No.2277 of 2020 arising out of Criminal Case No.43 of 2018, under Sections 498A, 323, 504 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act,
Police Station - Kaptanganj, District Kushinagar pending in the court of Civil Judge (C.D.)/A.C.J.M.,
Kushinagar at Padrauna.
3.
Contention of learned counsel for the applicant is that the applicant no.1 is husband of opposite party no.2 while applicant nos.2 to 5 are family members of applicant no.1.
He further submits that on the general allegations entire family members of applicant no.1 have been implicated.

sentences.text: Per contra, learned AGA submits that from the statement of victim girl recorded under Section 200 Cr.P.C, it is clear that there are specific allegations against the applicants for beating the opposite party no.2 for dowry demand.
It was also submitted by learned AGA that during the impugned proceeding at the persuasion of the court, opposite party no.2 had accompanied with applicant no.1.
Thereafter she was beaten by the applicants and thrown out from in-law's house.
Therefore, she lodged an FIR under Sections 498-A, 323, 504, 506 IPC.Therefore, the applicants are not entitled for any relief.

5. Considering the nature of allegations as well as taken into account the applicants have already been released on bail and there are specific allegations against the applicants, therefore this Court does not find any good ground to quash the proceeding.
6. Accordingly, the present application is dismissed.

Order Date :- 12.4.2024 A.Kr.
